english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for surroundings and influences, and can also mean the natural environment when the context makes that clear.
Choose this when “surroundings” means the overall environment or setting, including its conditions and atmosphere.
Use this as the all-purpose rendering for a surrounding environment or setting, including a social one.
Use this for the environment or general conditions in which someone or something exists.
